records.title: School Referrals (KidsAbility School)
records.summary: KidsAbility School runs half-day, one-year junior kindergarten programs in Waterloo and Cambridge for children with complex needs. KidsAbility therapists start the referral with the family and submit it to the principal in February; a selection committee decides and families hear in the spring. The child must be a KidsAbility client, 4 years old by December 31, with moderate to severe needs. Applying does not guarantee a place.

records.title: KidsAbility School Authority Special Education Plan 2026 (PDF)
records.summary: The authority's annual special education plan. Students are fully transitioned to the local boards by the end of the one-year Year One Kindergarten program; transition meetings start in the fall and a special education liaison teacher supports the move to community school. The plan also covers IPRC information, IEPs and early identification.

records.title: KidsAbility School Authority Special Education Plan 2026 (PDF), section 17
records.summary: The school council, called the Special Education School Advisory Council or Parent Engagement Team, gives advice on parent engagement. It meets four to five times a year, is open to families of current or former KidsAbility clients and is consulted on the calendar, IEP and transition meeting timing and the strategic plan. Involvement is limited to one year.

records.title: KidsAbility School Authority Special Education Plan 2026 (PDF), section 16
records.summary: Transportation is provided for all students who attend KidsAbility School through a contracted local company whose drivers are trained on students' needs; the company holds an orientation for families before school starts.

records.title: KidsAbility School Authority Multi-Year Accessibility Plan (PDF)
records.summary: The authority's AODA multi-year accessibility plan, dated 2025, available in accessible formats on request. Its accessibility compliance report is linked on the About page.

records.title: Policy 1012 Expressions of Concern (PDF)
records.summary: Concerns are handled as close to the issue as possible: staff refer you to the teacher or the principal or senior administrator, who acknowledge the concern and follow up. Anonymous complaints may be looked at but cannot get a reply.

records.title: KidsAbility School 2024-2027 Strategic Plan (PDF)
records.summary: The school's 2024-2027 strategic plan, with the mission of helping students succeed in school and life. It is a multi-year strategic plan, not a test-score achievement plan.
